metadata.name: RAG (Qdrant)
metadata.summary: Semantic search, ingestion and deletion over a Qdrant collection
metadata.description: Design extension exposing six tools to both the agentic worker and flow nodes: rag_search, rag_upsert, rag_ingest, rag_delete, rag_collection_ensure and rag_list. Text is embedded through a configurable OpenAI-shaped embeddings API; callers holding their own vectors can pass them directly. Ingestion chunks a document, deletes that doc_id's previous chunks, then upserts the new ones, so re-ingesting never duplicates or orphans content. rag_list enumerates stored documents, grouped by doc_id, using Qdrant's scroll API with pagination surfaced to the caller.

requiredSecrets.description: Qdrant API key, sent as the `api-key` header. Resolved by the host and never returned to the model.
Bearer token for the embeddings API configured in `embedding.base_url`.
